name: PharmaBlock Sciences (Nanjing), Inc.
summary: PharmaBlock Sciences (Nanjing), Inc. provides chemistry products and services throughout the pharmaceutical research and development, and commercial manufacturing in China and internationally. It offers medicinal chemistry-oriented SAR/SPR tool kits for molecule design; building blocks enabled libraries, including fragment-based drug discovery, and mega virtual library screening to support the discovery of novel hit compounds; custom synthesis (FFS); and full time equivalent (FTE).
